params.body:
**Merge after the gentells-site pull request that takes Standard 0.19.0 is deployed.** The site holds every trend and post whose tags its own copy of the Standard does not know; on its current copy a tag for Belgium would take the item off the site.

## Why

The Gentells Standard 0.19.0 makes Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg regions under Benelux (Trendwolves/gentells-standard#26), so that a reading can be made for Belgium. The classifier is handed the regions from the pinned Standard; until the pipeline takes this version it cannot answer with a country.

## What

- **The pinned Standard moves from v0.18.0 to v0.19.0** (`bin/sync-standard.mjs`; `packages/core/standard.mjs`, the types and the conformance fixture are generated).
- **The region tree has a third level.** `CONTINENTS` was every region with regions under it, which made Benelux a fifth continent. A continent is now a region at the top with regions under it; `REGION_GROUPS` names a region that holds countries (Benelux), and `continentOf` gives the continent of a region however deep.
- **Trend origin** (`trend-origin.mjs`) reads the continent through `continentOf`, so a Belgian source lies in Europe and not in "Benelux" as a continent.
- **The classifier prompt** says of a group region: only for something about all its countries together, never for one of them; and of the list: a country where one is listed and the signal shows it.
- **Source lists** (`source-list.mjs`): België, Vlaanderen and Brussel map to `region-belgium`, Nederland to `region-netherlands`, Benelux stays Benelux.

## Changed in practice

- Signals classified from here on carry the country where the signal shows one. What was tagged Benelux stays Benelux; nothing is reclassified.
- A filter on Benelux finds the countries under it (`regionAndBelow`, already in the query, the tools and the store). The Mix by region does not roll a child up into its parent, so its Benelux row will shrink as Belgium and the Netherlands appear beside it.
- The country code of an adapter (`BE` from Google Trends, YouTube, the charts) now resolves to Belgium, so the origin line of a trend on the site can say Belgium.
- A source imported from a list from now on is hinted with its country. Sources already imported keep `region-benelux`.
- The classify prompt changes, so its hash does; the frozen bench suites keep their own taxonomy.

Not measured: how well the model tells a Belgian from a Dutch signal in Dutch-language text without a place name. A sample of the first days should say, before a Belgian reading is promised.

## Checked

- The copy comes from the tag: same digest as a local checkout of the merged Standard.
- Tests moved to the new answers: a country code is stored as its country and found under Benelux and under Europe; the tree below Europe and below Benelux; the four continents, with Benelux as a group and not a fifth; the continent of a country in the trend origin; the prompt's wording for a group; the source list wording.
- Full suite 1737/1737, `tsc` clean.
params.title: Take Gentells Standard 0.19.0: Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg under Benelux
